addonAfter.zh-CN: 后置标签，显示在输入框外部的右侧。
addonAfter.en-US: Trailing addon, shown outside the input on the right.

addonBefore.zh-CN: 前置标签，显示在输入框外部的左侧。
addonBefore.en-US: Leading addon, shown outside the input on the left.

aria-describedby.zh-CN: 引用描述元素的 id，作为输入框的描述。
aria-describedby.en-US: Id of the element describing the input.

aria-errormessage.zh-CN: 引用错误信息元素的 id。
aria-errormessage.en-US: Id of the element with the error message.

aria-invalid.zh-CN: 是否校验失败。`validateStatus` 为 `error` 时固定为 `true`。
aria-invalid.en-US: Whether validation failed. Fixed to `true` when `validateStatus` is `error`.

aria-labelledby.zh-CN: 引用标签元素的 id，作为输入框的可访问名称。未设置且有内嵌标签（`insetLabel`）时指向该标签。
aria-labelledby.en-US: Id of the element labelling the input, used as its accessible name. When not set and there is an inset label (`insetLabel`), it points to that label.

autofocus.zh-CN: 原生 `autofocus` 属性，落在原生 `input` 上。
autofocus.en-US: The native `autofocus` attribute, set on the native `input`.

className.en-US: Class name of the root element (`.semi-input-number`).

clearIcon.zh-CN: 清除按钮的图标，可传 ReactNode。仅 `showClear` 为 `true` 时有效。
clearIcon.en-US: Icon of the clear button, as a ReactNode. Takes effect only when `showClear` is `true`.

composition.zh-CN: 是否启用输入法组合模式。开启后组合输入期间不触发 `onChange`，组合结束后触发一次。
composition.en-US: Whether to enable composition mode. When enabled, `onChange` is not called during IME composition and is called once after it ends.

currency.zh-CN: 货币种类，可选值有 CNY、EUR、USD 等。设为 `true` 时使用 `defaultCurrency`，未设置时为语言包对应的货币。
currency.en-US: Currency, such as CNY, EUR or USD. When `true`, uses `defaultCurrency`, or the currency of the locale pack when that is not set.

currencyDisplay.en-US: How the currency is shown: `symbol`, `code` or `name`.

defaultCurrency.zh-CN: `currency` 为 `true` 时使用的货币种类，优先级为自身属性、全局默认值、语言包。
defaultCurrency.en-US: Currency used when `currency` is `true`. Priority: own prop, global default, locale pack.

disabled.zh-CN: 是否禁用。未设置时使用所在 `InputGroup` 的值。
disabled.en-US: Whether disabled. Falls back to the value of the enclosing `InputGroup` when not set.

formatter.zh-CN: 指定输入框展示值的格式，一般与 `parser` 同时设置。
formatter.en-US: Format of the displayed value, usually set together with `parser`.

getValueLength.zh-CN: 计算文本长度的函数。设置后由它校验 `maxLength` 与 `minLength`，原生 `maxlength` 属性不再生效。
getValueLength.en-US: Function that measures the text length. When set, it enforces `maxLength` and `minLength` instead of the native `maxlength` attribute.

hideButtons.zh-CN: 隐藏步进按钮；与 `innerButtons` 同时为 `true` 时也不显示内置按钮。
hideButtons.en-US: Hides the step buttons; with `innerButtons` also `true`, no built-in button is shown either.

hideSuffix.zh-CN: 清除按钮显示时隐藏后缀，默认两者并列。
hideSuffix.en-US: Hides the suffix while the clear button is shown; by default the two sit side by side.

innerButtons.zh-CN: 将步进按钮放在输入框内部，悬停或聚焦时显示，并临时替换 `suffix`。
innerButtons.en-US: Puts the step buttons inside the input, shown on hover or focus and temporarily replacing `suffix`.

insetLabel.zh-CN: 内嵌标签，显示在输入框内部。
insetLabel.en-US: Inset label, shown inside the input.

insetLabelId.en-US: The id of the inset label.

inputStyle.zh-CN: 原生 `input` 的样式，类型为 `CSSProperties`。
inputStyle.en-US: Style of the native `input`, typed as `CSSProperties`.

keepFocus.zh-CN: 点击步进按钮时保持输入框聚焦。
keepFocus.en-US: Keeps the input focused when a step button is clicked.

localeCode.zh-CN: 货币模式下用于格式化的语言地区代码，如 zh-CN、en-US、de-DE。优先级为自身属性、全局默认值、LocaleProvider 或 ConfigProvider 的语言包。
localeCode.en-US: Locale code used for formatting in currency mode, such as zh-CN, en-US or de-DE. Priority: own prop, global default, locale pack of LocaleProvider or ConfigProvider.

maximumFractionDigits.zh-CN: 显示的最大小数位数，传给 `Intl.NumberFormat`。
maximumFractionDigits.en-US: Maximum number of fraction digits shown, passed to `Intl.NumberFormat`.

minimumFractionDigits.zh-CN: 显示的最小小数位数，传给 `Intl.NumberFormat`。
minimumFractionDigits.en-US: Minimum number of fraction digits shown, passed to `Intl.NumberFormat`.

mode.zh-CN: 输入框模式，可选 `password`，此时显示切换可见性的按钮。
mode.en-US: Input mode, `password`, which shows a button to toggle visibility.

onBlur.zh-CN: 失去焦点时的回调，事件为输入框外层的 `focusout`。
onBlur.en-US: Called when focus leaves the input; the event is the `focusout` of the wrapper.

onChange.zh-CN: 值变化时的回调，第一个参数为展示值（`number` 或 `string`），第二个参数 `e` 为触发变化的输入、步进按钮的 `pointerdown`、方向键或 Home/End 键、失焦事件。挂载和 `value` 变化不触发，越界值按原样显示，用户操作时才校正并通知。
onChange.en-US: Called when the value changes, with the displayed value (`number` or `string`) and `e`, which is the typing, the `pointerdown` of a step button, the arrow or Home/End keydown, or the blur that caused it. Mounting and `value` changes do not call it; an out-of-range value is shown as given and is corrected and reported only after a user action.

onClear.zh-CN: 点击清除按钮时的回调。
onClear.en-US: Called when the clear button is clicked.

onDownClick.zh-CN: 点击减小按钮时的回调，参数为步进后的值与 `pointerdown` 事件。长按连续步进时每步都触发，事件为按下时的那一个。
onDownClick.en-US: Called when the decrease button is clicked, with the stepped value and the `pointerdown` event. While held, it is called on every step with the event that began the press.

onEnterPress.zh-CN: 按下 Enter 键时的回调。
onEnterPress.en-US: Called when the Enter key is pressed.

onFocus.zh-CN: 获得焦点时的回调，事件为输入框外层的 `focusin`。
onFocus.en-US: Called when focus enters the input; the event is the `focusin` of the wrapper.

onInput.zh-CN: 原生 `input` 的 `input` 事件回调，经透传交给输入框。
onInput.en-US: Called on the native `input` event of the input, passed through to it.

onKeyDown.zh-CN: 按下键盘按键时的回调，事件为输入框上的 `keydown`。
onKeyDown.en-US: Called when a key is pressed in the input; the event is its `keydown`.

onKeyUp.zh-CN: 松开键盘按键时的回调，事件为输入框上的 `keyup`。
onKeyUp.en-US: Called when a key is released in the input; the event is its `keyup`.

onNumberChange.zh-CN: 数字变化时的回调，第一个参数为数字，第二个参数的含义同 `onChange`。
onNumberChange.en-US: Called when the number changes; the first argument is the number, and the second is as in `onChange`.

onUpClick.zh-CN: 点击增大按钮时的回调，参数为步进后的值与 `pointerdown` 事件。长按连续步进时每步都触发，事件为按下时的那一个。
onUpClick.en-US: Called when the increase button is clicked, with the stepped value and the `pointerdown` event. While held, it is called on every step with the event that began the press.

parser.zh-CN: 指定从 `formatter` 的展示文本转换回数字串的方式，与 `formatter` 搭配使用。
parser.en-US: Converts the text from `formatter` back to a number string; used together with `formatter`.

precision.zh-CN: 数值精度，即保留的小数位数。
precision.en-US: Numerical precision, the number of fraction digits kept.

prefix.zh-CN: 前缀内容，显示在输入框内部的左侧。
prefix.en-US: Prefix content, shown inside the input on the left.

prefixCls.zh-CN: 组件样式类名的前缀，根元素类名为前缀加 `-number`，默认前缀为 `semi-input`，根元素类名即 `semi-input-number`。
prefixCls.en-US: Class name prefix of the component; the root class is the prefix plus `-number`. The default prefix is `semi-input`, so the root class is `semi-input-number`.

preventScroll.zh-CN: 聚焦时是否阻止浏览器滚动文档以显示输入框，作用于组件内的聚焦，包括句柄 `focus()` 未传 `preventScroll` 时的默认值。
preventScroll.en-US: Whether focusing stops the browser from scrolling the document to the input; applies to focusing inside the component, including the default of the handle's `focus()`.

pressInterval.zh-CN: 长按步进按钮时，连续触发的间隔，单位毫秒。
pressInterval.en-US: Interval in milliseconds between repeats while a step button is held.

pressTimeout.zh-CN: 长按步进按钮时，开始连续触发前的延迟，单位毫秒。
pressTimeout.en-US: Delay in milliseconds before repeating starts while a step button is held.

readonly.zh-CN: 是否只读。锁定输入并隐藏清除按钮，原生 `readOnly` 只锁定输入。
readonly.en-US: Whether read-only. Locks typing and hides the clear button; the native `readOnly` locks typing only.

ref.zh-CN: 组件的命令式句柄，类型为 `InputNumberHandle`，不是原生 DOM 节点。成员见下方 Methods。
ref.en-US: Imperative handle of the component, typed `InputNumberHandle`, not a native DOM node. Its members are listed in Methods below.

scientificNotation.zh-CN: 启用科学计数法显示：失焦时显示科学计数法，聚焦时显示完整数字。可传入 `{ threshold }` 配置阈值，默认 15 位有效数字。不支持货币模式。
scientificNotation.en-US: Shows scientific notation when blurred and the full number when focused. Pass `{ threshold }` to configure the threshold, 15 significant digits by default. Not supported in currency mode.

shiftStep.zh-CN: 按住 Shift 时每次改变的步长，可以为小数。
shiftStep.en-US: Step of each change while Shift is held; may be a decimal.

showClear.en-US: Whether to show the clear button.

showClearIgnoreDisabled.zh-CN: 内部属性，由 DatePicker 设置，使用方一般不需要传入。
showClearIgnoreDisabled.en-US: Internal prop set by DatePicker; callers normally do not pass it.

showCurrencySymbol.zh-CN: 是否显示货币符号、代码或名称，仅货币模式下生效。
showCurrencySymbol.en-US: Whether to show the currency symbol, code or name; only in currency mode.

size.zh-CN: 输入框大小，可选 `default`、`small`、`large`。所在 `InputGroup` 设置了 `size` 时以其为准。
size.en-US: Input size: `default`, `small` or `large`. The `size` of the enclosing `InputGroup` takes precedence when it is set.

step.zh-CN: 每次改变的步长，可以为小数。
step.en-US: Step of each change; may be a decimal.

suffix.zh-CN: 后缀内容，显示在输入框内部的右侧。
suffix.en-US: Suffix content, shown inside the input on the right.

type.zh-CN: 原生 `input` 的 `type` 属性，默认为 `text`。
type.en-US: The `type` attribute of the native `input`, `text` by default.

value.zh-CN: 当前值，传入即为受控，需要配合 `onChange` 更新。传 `undefined` 时按非受控处理。
value.en-US: Current value; passing it makes the component controlled, so update it in `onChange`. An explicit `undefined` is treated as uncontrolled.

onlyBorder.zh-CN: 内部属性，指定外框的边框宽度（像素），由其他组件设置，使用方一般不需要传入。
onlyBorder.en-US: Internal prop giving the border width of the wrapper in pixels, set by other components; callers normally do not pass it.

focus.zh-CN: 获取输入框焦点。`options.preventScroll` 未传时使用 `preventScroll` 属性的值。
focus.en-US: Focuses the input. When `options.preventScroll` is not passed, the value of the `preventScroll` prop is used.

select.zh-CN: 选中输入框中的全部文本。
select.en-US: Selects all the text in the input.

setSelectionRange.zh-CN: 设置输入框的选区，参数同原生 `setSelectionRange`。
setSelectionRange.en-US: Sets the selection of the input; the arguments are those of the native `setSelectionRange`.

input.zh-CN: 原生 `input` 元素，卸载后为 `null`。
